name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: Custom checkbox: a real <input> (kept accessible + form-native) visually replaced by a themed box. Sizing/colors come from tokens, like the controls. Copy: the label is the positive statement the tick makes true — "Send me the weekly digest", never "Do not send…". A negative label makes an unticked box mean yes.
